q_purpose: Deterministic nonzero controls for preserving other rates; not a draw from a physical prior

bbn.initialization: Unchanged native standard initialization in both arms; saved dense solution must have bitwise identical Y(t0)

criteria.input_provenance: matching shared NPZ SHA256, contract SHA256, source SHA, environment and reaction order

criteria_basis: Strict engineering regression budget chosen before any BBN outcome: relative 1e-10, 1e4 below the solver rtol; absolute trace floor 1e-18, 1e9 below solver atol. These ratios are design separation, NOT error estimates or guarantees. Both arms use the same interpolation, so no new interpolation-error allowance is added. Bitwise output equality is reported but not required. Any breach remains FAIL without automatic threshold change or rerun.
dynamic_table_change: Separate later test only after identity PASS; not executed by this pair
jit_reuse: Not assessed by two isolated processes; requires the later same-process dynamic-table test

runtime.required_before_execution: Fresh controller admission including Actions AND local ledger, source SHA and actual target-host calibration/route. The 2.6 s boundary probe is not a BBN calibration.
